name: Exp_AroonOscillatorSignAlert
summary: This EA trades based on the Aroon Oscillator indicator with alert signals. It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Aroon振荡器指标的信号进行交易。在向上穿越信号时开多仓，在向下穿越信号时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Aroon振荡器指标（AroonOscillatorSignAlert自定义指标）作为核心交易信号源。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在设定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓信号；当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）产生有效信号时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓信号。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，同时也支持反向信号平仓——当同时启用买入和卖出开平仓时，EA会回溯历史K线寻找反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例和固定手数。资金管理采用固定止损止盈点数方式，无动态调整机制，缺乏根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈的能力。整体策略属于典型的动量跟随系统，依赖Aroon振荡器穿越阈值水平来判断趋势动量变化。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Aroon Oscillator indicator (custom AroonOscillatorSignAlert indicator) as its core signal source. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the configured signal bar, it triggers a buy open and sell close signal; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a valid signal, it triggers a sell open and buy close signal. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings, and also support reverse-signal closing — when both buy and sell open/close are enabled, the EA retrospects historical bars to find opposing signals to determine whether to close positions. Position sizing supports five modes via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by net free margin percentage, by net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management uses fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points with no dynamic adjustment mechanism, lacking the ability to adapt stops and targets based on market volatility. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-following system relying on the Aroon Oscillator crossing threshold levels to detect trend momentum changes.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小比例或手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/净自由保证金/净余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平多仓）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平空仓）

parameters.name: ATR_Period
parameters.description: ATR周期（注意：此变量未声明为input，为硬编码）
parameters.description_en: ATR period (Note: not declared as input, hardcoded)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于Aroon振荡器的动量信号有明确的理论基础
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活性较高，适应不同风险偏好
支持独立的买入/卖出开平仓开关，可实现只做多、只做空或双向交易
使用SignalBar参数控制信号确认时机，避免未收盘K线的虚假信号
包含新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar），避免同一根K线重复开仓
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the Aroon Oscillator momentum signals with solid theoretical foundation
Five position sizing modes offer good flexibility to suit different risk preferences
Independent buy/sell open/close switches enable long-only, short-only, or bidirectional trading
SignalBar parameter controls signal confirmation timing, avoiding false signals from uncompleted bars
New bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar) prevents duplicate entries on the same bar
cons: ATR_Period变量未声明为input类型，无法在策略测试器中优化，属于代码缺陷
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率变化（如ATR动态止损），在低波动和高波动市场中表现差异大
回溯历史K线寻找反向平仓信号的循环（第142-163行）可能效率低下，在大量历史数据时存在性能问题
缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时仍会开仓，可能导致入场成本过高
没有持仓检查和最大持仓数限制，可能因信号密集产生过多持仓
注释为乱码（编码问题），严重影响代码可读性和可维护性
cons_en: ATR_Period is not declared as an input parameter, making it non-optimizable in the strategy tester — a code defect
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points ignores market volatility changes (e.g., ATR-based dynamic stops), leading to inconsistent performance across varying volatility regimes
The historical bar loop for finding reverse closing signals (lines 142-163) can be inefficient with large bar counts, posing potential performance issues
No spread filter mechanism — trades open even with wide spreads, potentially resulting in excessive entry costs
No position count check or maximum position limit, which may lead to excessive positions from dense signal clusters
Comments are garbled (encoding issue), severely harming code readability and maintainability
improvements: 将ATR_Period声明为input参数，使其可在策略测试器中优化，并修复文件编码问题恢复中文注释
增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈选项，以及点差过滤和最大持仓数限制，提升风险管理的适应性
improvements_en: Declare ATR_Period as an input parameter for strategy tester optimization, and fix file encoding to restore Chinese comments
Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit options, a spread filter, and maximum position limits to improve risk management adaptability

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不适应市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过大、高波动时止盈难以触及
无点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大时仍会入场
无最大持仓数限制，信号密集期可能累积过多仓位
回溯历史K线的循环无上界保护，极端情况下可能遍历过多K线
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss/take-profit doesn't adapt to volatility changes — stops too wide in low volatility, targets hard to reach in high volatility
No spread filter — entries execute even when spreads widen during volatile periods
No maximum position limit — dense signals may accumulate excessive exposure
Historical bar loop has no upper bound protection, potentially iterating too many bars in extreme cases

summary_en: This EA trades based on the Aroon Oscillator indicator with alert signals. It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
